searchText: <shemnon> Is there a next meeting scheduled? Is this meeting on a 4 week cadence? <davidecrapis> re: **@shemnon** > Is there a next meeting scheduled? Is this meeting on a 4 week cadence? We don’t have the next meeting scheduled yet. Let me find a time that works Would you like to add memory cost discussion to the agenda? <shemnon> That needs discussion, yes. But is it the only topic that would be ready? If there is no progress on other subjects we should probably wait. <davidecrapis> Another potential topic would be discussing the two min blob price eips, 7762 and 7918 I know we said last time that this is not strictly EVM pricing but Ethereum resource pricing more broadly. How do you feel about including these topics? <davidecrapis> Will also do a check on other potential topics For the group: please post here if there’s anything you’d like to discuss in the next call <shemnon> blob pricing feels a bit like scope creep, but I'm not sure what other group they would land in. My main concern is that it involves more economics than engineering, and that we may not have the right experts on the call.
